scenes.title: A narrow habitable world
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice someone unable to flee like everyone else Enter a family’s life between fire and ice Understand why this vulnerable people values safety
scenes.composition: The inhabited twilight belt appears between heat and cold
addOrChange: Add ordinary Nivari with source-grounded bodies, avoiding monster styling.

cues.narration: On a world shaped by fleeing predators, one man does not run quickly enough.
cues.visualAction: One figure pauses while others reflexively retreat from a harmless shadow.

cues.narration: Those Who No Longer Run follows a family living in a narrow belt between permanent fire and ice.
cues.visualAction: Reveal the narrow habitable belt around the family’s world.

cues.narration: The Nivari have built cities and institutions to keep their vulnerable species safe.
cues.visualAction: Bring protected underground homes into view.

scenes.title: A family before the crisis
scenes.viewerPurpose: See safety deciding which bodies count as normal Feel Taren being judged for a difference
scenes.composition: Family life includes food allocation and health observations
addOrChange: Keep later political outcomes out of the domestic scene.

cues.narration: That need for safety shapes their food, family life, and the bodies they consider normal.
cues.visualAction: Show ordinary care and food rules around the family.

cues.narration: Taren’s delayed flight response is treated as a defect.
cues.visualAction: A health note marks Taren’s delayed response while family stay nearby.

scenes.title: The delayed reflex
scenes.viewerPurpose: Meet the family working to sustain their world Sense the daughter’s loyalties coming under pressure Ask who decides what courage looks like
scenes.composition: Sava studies records while Oru maintains living water systems
addOrChange: Replace therapy diagram with family work and a distant rehearsal shadow.

cues.narration: His sister studies the population, while her partner maintains the living systems beneath their home.
cues.visualAction: Show the sister’s records and her partner’s practical maintenance.

cues.narration: Their daughter grows up among loyalties that an approaching crisis will test.
cues.visualAction: Nemi observes affectionate disagreement among the adults.

cues.narration: The story asks how fear shapes a society, and who gets to decide what courage looks like.
cues.visualAction: Different reactions to the shadow leave courage undefined.

scenes.title: Listen before running
scenes.viewerPurpose: See the familiar pain of not fitting in Want to know Taren before judging his difference
scenes.composition: Taren stays with Nemi before the public crisis

cues.narration: These unfamiliar people face a familiar problem: being different can make it hard to belong.
cues.visualAction: Taren pauses at a gathering while Nemi remains beside him.

cues.narration: Meet Taren through the family who know him, before deciding what his difference means.
cues.visualAction: End with the family’s view rather than the public label.
